# Mengirim Pesan

Semua jenis pesan dikirim pake satu fungsi: `sock.sendMessage(jid, content, options)`.

## Parameter

| Parameter | Tipe | Wajib | Deskripsi |
|---|---|---|---|
| `jid` | `string` | ✅ | ID tujuan (nomor/grup/channel) |
| `content` | `AnyMessageContent` | ✅ | Isi pesan (text, image, video, dll) |
| `options` | `MiscMessageGenerationOptions` | ❌ | Opsi tambahan (quoted, ephemeral, dll) |

## Format JID

| Tipe | Format | Contoh |
|---|---|---|
| Personal | `nomor@s.whatsapp.net` | `6281234567890@s.whatsapp.net` |
| Grup | `id@g.us` | `123456789-12345@g.us` |
| Channel | `id@newsletter` | `120363...@newsletter` |

## Text Message

```ts
await sock.sendMessage('6281234567890@s.whatsapp.net', {
  text: 'Halo! Ini pesan dari bot '
})
```

## Quote / Reply

```ts
const reply = await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  text: 'Ini reply ke pesan sebelumnya'
}, {
  quoted: originalMessage // object WAMessage
})
```

## Mention

```ts
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  text: 'Halo @62812345678',
  mentions: ['62812345678@s.whatsapp.net']
})
```

## Forward

```ts
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  forward: originalMessage // object WAMessage
})
```

## Reaction

```ts
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  react: {
    text: '',
    key: messageKey
  }
})

// Untuk hapus reaction:
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  react: {
    text: '',
    key: messageKey
  }
})
```

## Edit Pesan

```ts
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  text: 'Teks yang sudah diedit',
  edit: messageKey
})
```

## Delete Pesan

```ts
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  delete: messageKey
})
```

## Image

```ts
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  image: { url: 'https://example.com/gambar.jpg' },
  caption: 'Gambar keren!'
})

// Atau dari file lokal:
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  image: fs.readFileSync('gambar.jpg'),
  caption: 'Gambar lokal'
})
```

## Video

```ts
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  video: { url: './video.mp4' },
  caption: 'Video keren!',
  ptv: false // true = video note (lingkaran)
})
```

## Audio

```ts
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  audio: { url: './audio.mp3' },
  mimetype: 'audio/mp4',
  ptt: true // true = voice note
})
```

## Document

```ts
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  document: { url: './file.pdf' },
  fileName: 'dokumen.pdf',
  mimetype: 'application/pdf'
})
```

## Sticker

```ts
// Dari gambar
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  sticker: { url: './sticker.webp' }
})
```

## Location

```ts
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  location: {
    degreesLatitude: -6.2088,
    degreesLongitude: 106.8456
  }
})
```

## Contact

```ts
const vcard = [
  'BEGIN:VCARD',
  'VERSION:3.0',
  'FN:Ibra Decode',
  'TEL;type=CELL;waid=6281234567890:+62 812 3456 7890',
  'END:VCARD'
].join('\n')

await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  contacts: {
    displayName: 'Ibra Decode',
    contacts: [{ vcard }]
  }
})
```

## Poll

```ts
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  poll: {
    name: 'Framework favorit?',
    values: ['Next.js', 'React', 'Vue', 'Svelte'],
    selectableCount: 1 // 1 = pilih satu, >1 = pilih banyak
  }
})
```

## View Once

```ts
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  image: { url: './foto.jpg' },
  caption: 'Foto rahasia',
  viewOnce: true
})
```

## Button / Interactive Message

```ts
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  text: 'Pilih salah satu:',
  buttons: [
    { buttonId: '1', buttonText: { displayText: 'Ya' }, type: 1 },
    { buttonId: '2', buttonText: { displayText: 'Tidak' }, type: 1 }
  ],
  footer: 'Footer teks',
  headerType: 1
})
```

## Link Preview

```ts
// Aktifin dulu generateHighQualityLinkPreview di config:
const sock = makeWASocket({
  generateHighQualityLinkPreview: true,
  // ...
})

// Kirim link aja, otomatis generate preview:
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  text: 'Cek ini https://github.com/IbraDecode/Mataram'
})
```

## Menandai Pesan sebagai Penting / Pin

```ts
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  pin: {
    key: messageKey,
    type: 1, // 1 = pin, 0 = unpin
    time: 86400 // detik: 86400 = 24 jam, 604800 = 7 hari
  }
})
```

## Forward dengan Konteks

```ts
// Forward dengan caption tambahan
const forwarded = await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  forward: originalMessage
}, {
  contextInfo: {
    forwardingScore: 5, // jumlah kali di-forward
    isForwarded: true,
    mentionedJid: ['62812345678@s.whatsapp.net']
  }
})
```

## Disappearing Messages

```ts
// Kirim pesan yang otomatis ilang:
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  text: 'Pesan ini ilang dalam 24 jam'
}, {
  ephemeralExpiration: 86400 // detik: 86400 = 24 jam
})

// Atur disappearing message di chat:
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  disappearingMessagesInChat: 86400
})

// Matikan:
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  disappearingMessagesInChat: false
})
```
